Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning environmental impact statements on certain state trust lands.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to environmental impact statements for class I, II,and III forest practices on state trust lands; and adding a new sectionto chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: On state trust lands, class I, II, and III forest practices, asdefined by rules adopted by the forest practices board under RCW76.09.050, do not require an environmental impact statement or detailedstatement required under this chapter if a programmatic detailedenvironmental impact statement has been finalized for the ten-yearsustained yield plan required for all forest practices on state landsunder chapter 79.68 RCW. State trust lands include federally grantedtrust lands, forest board transfer lands, forest board purchase lands,and the community college reserve trust lands.
